assessment: This paper investigated the structural changes in the insulin and IGF1 receptors caused by ligand binding using cryo-electron microscopy and found that the disulfide-linked C-terminal segment of α-chains of these receptors are important for receptor activation. This is an important manuscript that addresses a research question of interest to the fields of metabolism, cancer, growth and aging. It provides convincing mechanistic insights into the roles of the disulfide linked C-terminal segment of the α-chains of the IR and IGF1R and their activation.
